# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,

Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.

  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.

  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling

pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and
socio-economic barriers. This aptitude of ours can be credited to our successful portfolio of
businesses.

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we
endeavor to build blocks to produce an organization that manufactures therapeutics for a variety of
diseases.

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a

# **Best Pharma Franchise Company in India**

quality pharmaceutical products for franchise business and third party manufacturing services. The
company work under the norms set by the (WHO) World Health Organisation and (GMP) Goods
Manufacturing Practice which enables us to match the global standard of the products and company.

Serving with the wide range of quality pharma products with DCGI and FSSAI approval makes us the
ideal platform to get effective medicines for some special ranges. Our all products are widely
preferred because our all products are manufactured in a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility
with the assistance of experts. We cover product segments like;-
* Antibiotics
* Anti-infective
* Pediatric
* Health Supplements
* Cardiology
* Diabetology
* Gynecology
* Dry Injectables
* Softgel
* Anti-Hiv

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

### A Trusted Pharmaceutical Company manufacturing Bulk Drug API

[about]

APMIDA Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. manufacturing Bulk Drug API derived from various chemicals which
have a growing demand globally. The company is linked with developed pieces of equipment of the
technology and machinery for the process of the manufacturing of the Medicine product. The state of
the art manufacturing is Drug licensed and GMP and ISO certifications. Along with this, our
production place has the following amenities:
* #### We have vast and spacious warehouse in excise free zones to do the other activities of the
  #### manufacturing of the drugs.
* #### Quality control Lab and Analytical Testing along with R&D Manufacturing facilities
* #### State Drug licenses
* #### FDA Registered

### We are Helping to Advance Health with Clinical Trials for Medicine.

APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. is a vertically integrated company that develops, manufactures, and
sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique
research and synthesis facility reflects our commitment to research and innovation. The world-class
manufacturing facilities at APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. are located in Dist. Rampur (UP)India.
These facilities are benchmarked to international standards and set to meet the rigorous quality
guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

As a leading API supplier, our regulatory-approved facilities enable us to supply our partners all
over countries with a broad portfolio of products. Our expertise spans a variety of chemical
processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from
500MT/year to 800MT/Year.

  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

### Bora’s global manufacturing footprint
* Our worldwide presence and deep regulatory expertise enable partners to meet country-specific
  commercial and regulatory requirements, ensuring therapies reach patients worldwide in the most
  efficient way possible

Bora currently owns and operates nine cGMP manufacturing facilities – in Taiwan, Canada, and the
United States – built to the highest international standards for pharmaceutical development,
manufacturing, packaging, labeling, and analytical testing.

We manufacture and supply finished drug products to countries in North, Central, and South America,
Europe, Russia, the Middle East, and Asia, as well as Australia and New Zealand.

Manufacturing sites approved by global regulatory authorities including USFDA, MHRA, Health Canada,
ANVISA, Japan FDA, Russian Ministry, Turkish MoH, Korean FDA, PIC/S, GMP, TFDA, Jordan FDA, and GCC

Working for a Safer Drug Supply Chain

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance. 

 

 

[Prescription Drugs]
[[Bar Chart]][11]
[[FDA-White-Oak-Building-01.jpg]][12]
[[Business Brainstorm]][13]

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

## Frequently asked questions

What is CatalystAlert?

CatalystAlert is a biotech catalyst tracking platform with AI-powered predictions that helps
investors monitor PDUFA dates, clinical trial results, FDA decisions, and predict stock price
movements for 1,600+ biotechnology companies.

How much does CatalystAlert cost?

CatalystAlert offers a free tier with a 7-day catalyst calendar view, company search and a
watchlist. Pro is $29.99/mo and unlocks the full calendar horizon plus AI predictions and alerts —
and starts with a 48-hour free trial (card required; cancel anytime before it ends and you are not
charged). Elite tier ($99.99/mo) coming soon with API access.

Where does CatalystAlert get its data?

CatalystAlert aggregates data from official sources including ClinicalTrials.gov, SEC EDGAR filings,
FDA openFDA database, EMA, and company press releases. Our ML models are trained on historical
catalyst outcomes with price data — see our public track record for how they have actually
performed.

What types of biotech catalysts are tracked?

We track PDUFA dates, Phase 1/2/3 clinical trial results, FDA Advisory Committee meetings (AdCom),
NDA/BLA filings, earnings reports, conference presentations, EMA approvals, and other regulatory
events worldwide.

How does CatalystAlert analyze catalysts?

We analyze catalyst characteristics, therapeutic area, clinical phase, FDA designations, historical
patterns, and market conditions to help you understand potential stock price impacts. Our
data-driven approach combines multiple factors for comprehensive catalyst analysis.

What is Likelihood of Approval (LOA)?

LOA is a probability score predicting the chance of FDA approval for a drug based on its phase,
therapeutic area, trial design, and special designations like Breakthrough Therapy or Fast Track.
Our Logistic Regression model is calibrated against BIO industry benchmarks.

How often is the data updated?

Core data syncs every 2-6 hours from official government databases. ML models are retrained weekly
with new outcomes. Real-time alerts notify subscribers within minutes of major announcements.

### [2026 Nasal & Inhalation Drug Development & Delivery eBook: Drug Repurposing Creates New Market
### Opportunities][16]

In this exclusive seventh annual nasal and inhalation eBook, Drug Development & Delivery highlights
how these routes of administration are bringing new life to orphaned drugs and open new
opportunities for treatment beyond pulmonary and respiratory diseases. We also explore the
challenges of nose-to-brain delivery, next-generation propellants, overcoming the limitations of dry
powder inhalers, and successful formulation strategies.

[Featured Articles][17]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - Outsourcing Formulation Development & Manufacturing: Connecting Your Project
### to the Right Service Provider][18]

Outsourcing formulation development and manufacturing can help drug developers address complex
dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

### [SPECIAL REPORT - Advancements in Respiratory Drug Delivery][20]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### [CONTROLLED RELEASE - Precision in Every Dose: Advancing Controlled Release for Small Molecule
### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

[Featured Articles][37]

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

## A Leading International Pharmaceutical Company located in Greece

The story of the Gerolymatos International **Pharma** began almost 100 years ago in 1923, when
pharmacist, Nikos Gerolymatos, opened his own pharmacy in the heart of Athens. The pharmacy became
one of the largest in the country and the small family business grew. Guided by the dedication of
its founder, the entrepreneurial spirit of his son, Panagiotis, and now his grandson, Nicholas,
Gerolymatos International, is today, one of the most historical, traditional and well-regarded
family businesses in the Greek healthcare industry.

Based in Athens, Greece, with affiliated companies in France, Italy and Cyprus, Gerolymatos
International has a significant **global presence in over 50 countries **worldwide through exclusive
distribution partnerships for its own brand portfolio, namely, **Sinomarin®** (natural nasal & ear
care sea water sprays & vials -medical devices) & **Tamarine®** (pharmaceutical natural laxative in
marmalade form).

With a fully-owned pumping and processing installation for sea water in the northern French Britany
coast –the cleanest, most pristine waters- and a dedicated manufacturing facility in Athens, Greece,
Gerolymatos International produces its Sinomarin product lines for 40 international markets. The
company also provides **contract manufacturing** for hypertonic and isotonic **seawater-based nasal
sprays** and has become a leading **sea water nasal spray manufacturer**, delivering highest quality
products on private label.

Gerolymatos International is committed to pharmaceutical manufacturing, research & development,
marketing, distribution and sales of its own of its own product lines as well as the exclusive
distribution of products from highly esteemed international partners.

With an enduring presence in the Greek domestic market, the company operates in three distinct
segments:
* **OTC division**: caters to the Pharmacy and Supermarket channels, marketing the Company’s own

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand

medicines across the world.

# Medical Device Innovations for ENT

Hogne is a cutting-edge medical technology company specializing in innovations and products within
the field of oto-rhino-laryngology, focusing on the areas of ear, nose, and throat. With a strong
commitment to advancing healthcare, Hogne AB continuously strives to revolutionize the medical
industry through groundbreaking solutions.

[
Advancing Precision Medicine

### Nasal Drug Delivery

Explore our patented TrigeNas™ platform — a multi-route nasal delivery technology unlocking direct
and efficient access to the brain and bloodstream.

Läs mer
][23][
Redefining Everyday Care

### Consumer Products

Discover our clinically designed consumer solutions that combine comfort, safety, and efficiency —
empowering patients to treat common ENT conditions with ease.

Läs mer
][24]

## Our mission

At HOGNE AB,our mission is to revolutionize healthcare through the development and delivery of
first-in-class medtech devices for the ear, nose, and throat (ENT) areas.

We are dedicated to improving the lives of people on a global basis by providing innovative and
effective solutions that enhance the treatment and overall well-being of individuals with ENT
conditions.

We strive to be at the forefront of technological advancements in the medical field, constantly
pushing boundaries and challenging the status quo. Our team of passionate and skilled professionals
work tirelessly to develop groundbreaking devices that address unmet needs and redefine the standard
of care in ENT treatments.

[
Read More
][25]
Hogne is dedicated to fostering strong partnerships with healthcare institutions, research
organizations, and regulatory bodies, working together to drive advancements in ENT medicine.

## Focus Areas

Hogne strive to develop cutting-edge medical devices that address a wide range of ENT conditions,
like:

[

### Epistaxis - common nosebleed

][26]
[

### External otitis - swimmer's ear

][27]
[

### Dry ears

][28]
[

### Nasal drug delivery

][29]
[

### Nasal vaccine delivery

][30]

## Our Core Values

### Innovation & Research

Our dedicated R&D team works tirelessly to explore new possibilities, technologies, and treatment
options.

### Patient-Centric Approach

By focusing on usability, comfort, and effectiveness, we aim to make medical treatments more
accessible.

### Quality & Compliance

We adhere to the highest industry standards and regulations to ensure the safety and efficacy of our
products.

# Medical Device Innovations for ENT

Hogne is a cutting-edge medical technology company specializing in innovations and products within
the field of oto-rhino-laryngology, focusing on the areas of ear, nose, and throat. With a strong
commitment to advancing healthcare, Hogne AB continuously strives to revolutionize the medical
industry through groundbreaking solutions.

[
Advancing Precision Medicine

### Nasal Drug Delivery

Explore our patented TrigeNas™ platform — a multi-route nasal delivery technology unlocking direct
and efficient access to the brain and bloodstream.

Läs mer

Redefining Everyday Care

### Consumer Products

Discover our clinically designed consumer solutions that combine comfort, safety, and efficiency —
empowering patients to treat common ENT conditions with ease.

Läs mer

## Our mission

At HOGNE AB,our mission is to revolutionize healthcare through the development and delivery of
first-in-class medtech devices for the ear, nose, and throat (ENT) areas.

We are dedicated to improving the lives of people on a global basis by providing innovative and
effective solutions that enhance the treatment and overall well-being of individuals with ENT
conditions.

We strive to be at the forefront of technological advancements in the medical field, constantly
pushing boundaries and challenging the status quo. Our team of passionate and skilled professionals
work tirelessly to develop groundbreaking devices that address unmet needs and redefine the standard
of care in ENT treatments.

[
Read More
][25]
Hogne is dedicated to fostering strong partnerships with healthcare institutions, research
organizations, and regulatory bodies, working together to drive advancements in ENT medicine.

like:

We adhere to the highest industry standards and regulations to ensure the safety and efficacy of our

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

[Full capabilities][21]
Built around the prescriber

## The people who choose the medicine are the people we work for.

Oncologists, nephrologists, hospital pharmacists, intensivists, procurement officers — these are the
audiences our scientific office, regulatory team and supply chain are designed around.

If you are one of them and you need product information, supply confirmation or a tender response,
our team is one enquiry away.

[Contact our team][22]
For healthcare professionals

## Need product information, availability or supply support?

Our scientific office responds to medical-information requests, hospital-procurement enquiries and
tender queries within one working day.

from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

About Us

Empowering Industries Worldwide with Proven Engineering Solutions

JD Engineers & Consultants, a subsidiary of [JD Pharma Consultants][87], was established in 2003 and
has built a strong global presence, successfully operating in over 13+ countries including the USA.

industries such as:
1.  Pharmaceuticals, API, Nutraceuticals, and Chemicals
2.  Food & Beverages, Edible Oil, and Vegetable Oil
3.  FMCG
4.  Yarns and Textiles
5.  BOPP Film
6.  Packaging
7.  Metals & General Engineering
8.  Automobile & Auto Ancillary
9.  Marine & Complex Structures, Glass, Ceramics, Pulp & Paper
10. Logistics & Warehousing
11. Renewable Energy, Polymers
12. Semiconductor
13. Data Center 
14. Oil and Gas Industries and more

## "Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value!"

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of
### generator at the warehouse for uninterrupted power supply. Cold Room Facilities are also
### available for storage.
* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Medicare
# Pharma

Somos un distribuidor farmacéutico autorizado como ‘Entidad de Distribución Farmacéutica Mayorista
de Medicamentos de Uso Humano’ con más de 15 años de experiencia.

La calidad de nuestro servicio está avalada, entre otros, por el Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de
Distribución (BPD), y contamos con las certificaciones ISO 9001:2015 e ISO 14001:2015.

Estamos especializados en distribución de medicamentos y productos hospitalarios de uso humano y
enfermedades raras. 

Medicare Pharma está compuesta por un equipo de profesionales formados y cualificados en el sector,
avalados con más de 30 años de experiencia en puestos de liderazgo en importantes compañías
nacionales e internacionales dentro de la industria farmacéutica, lo que nos permite aportar una
visión clara y completa a nuestros clientes.

Además, contamos con socios independientes y especializados en el área de desarrollo de negocio,
permitiendo aportar valor estratégico en las fases de implantación, desarrollo y consolidación del
modelo de negocio escogido por cada cliente.

## MISIÓN

### Distribución Farmacéutica

Control de la cadena de distribución de medicamentos, desde su importación hasta su dispensación,
garantizando la calidad de los mismos y asegurando las adecuadas condiciones de conservación,
transporte y suministro. Cumplimos con la normativa europea y contamos con la correspondiente
autorización de almacén distribución. Estamos especializados en la gestión de Medicamentos en
Situaciones Especiales teniendo como misión evitar lagunas terapéuticas ante la falta de suministro
de medicamentos en nuestro país.

### Representación local

Somos representantes locales de los laboratorios que distribuimos para el territorio español. Somos
los interlocutores autorizados con las administraciones oficiales ejerciendo las funciones y
asumiendo las responsabilidades derivadas.

### Responsabilidad

Las competencias y medios de Medicare Pharma garantizan cubrir las necesidades de los laboratorios
con quienes trabajamos, garantizando la distribución, cumplir con el marco regulatorio, gestionar la
relación con autoridades, controlar las licitaciones a nivel nacional, cubrir la farmacovigilancia,
registros y acceso a mercado.

### Red de ventas especializadas

Nuestro personal especializado con larga experiencia en el sector (departamento médico, MSL y Market
Access) cubre las funciones de introducción de productos en el mercado trabajando con los
especialistas, prescriptores y líderes de opinión de las distintas áreas terapéuticas.

## Nanopharm SmartTrack ™

Nanopharm has developed a unique proprietary in-vitro in-silico modeling system that can demonstrate
the comparative bioequivalence (BE) of inhaled generic drug products to reference listed products
without conducting a comparative clinical endpoint (CCEP) study.

[ Learn More About SmartTrack™ ][55]
[Round blue Nanopharm SmartTrack infographic showing 5 key parts of the in-silico in-vitro modelling
platform at Nanopharm.]

# Your Specialist CRO For Nasal & Inhaled Drug Products

Nanopharm is focused on providing highly specialized OINDP development and analytical services that
accelerate the development of your drug-device combination product and help bring it to market
faster.

Nanopharm applies its specialized expertise across a range of OINDP drug delivery formats and
molecule types. Our specialty is developing nasal and inhaled drug delivery products for small
molecules or biologics in combination with a variety of devices suitable for innovator, generic, or
lifecycle management applications.

## Nanopharm's OINDP Development Services

Our scientists are dedicated to advancing customer OINDP products from early development to cGMP
clinical stages and providing ongoing analytical support through to commercialization and beyond.
With over 20 years of experience developing some of the world’s most advanced nasal, inhaled, and
inhaled biologic products, Nanopharm offers the right support and services for virtually every stage
of your drug product’s development. All our services are backed by world-class regulatory support
and unrivaled scientific expertise.

As part of Aptar Pharma’s strategic expansion to support early-stage drug development, Nanopharm now
integrates the clinical trial manufacturing capabilities available at our newly acquired [Aptar
Pharma Services site in Boonton, NJ][56], a recognized leader in Phase 1 and 2 fill and finish
services for Orally Inhaled and Nasal Drug Products (OINDPs). This acquisition strengthens our
ability to offer end-to-end support from early development through clinical supply. Aptar Pharma
Services’ Boonton site combines decades of CMC experience with a laser focus on OINDPs to transform
your project into a clinic-ready proposition.

Using a stage-appropriate methodology within the Module 3 framework, our experts work
collaboratively with you to manage risk, mitigate delay and reduce cost while ensuring your OINDP
product’s quality, safety, and efficacy.

[Bearded and gloved scientist in white lab coat administers nasal spray to Nanopharm's Nasal CAST
in-vitro deposition model.]

# NARCAN^{®} NASAL SPRAY – ANYONE CAN SAVE A LIFE

Be ready – at home or on the go. NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray is a treatment designed to rapidly reverse
the effects of a life-threatening opioid emergency. Available as an over-the-counter medicine.

## BE PREPARED
## WITH NARCAN® NASAL SPRAY

Naloxone, the active ingredient in NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray, competes with opioids to bind with the
same receptors in the brain, reversing the effects of an opioid overdose in 2 to 3 minutes.

Carrying NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray can make all the difference in an opioid emergency.

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

[Narcan Usage Steps - Step One Lay]
**LAY**
* **Check for slowed breathing or unresponsiveness.**
* Lay the person on their back and tilt the head up.
**SPRAY**
* **Insert device into either nostril** and press plunger firmly.
**STAY**
* **Call 911 immediately** after giving the first dose. Continue to administer doses every 2-3
  minutes and wait with the person until help arrives. Use as directed. 1 nasal spray device
  contains 1 dose. Safe to keep giving doses as needed.

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

[Narcan Usage Steps - Step One Lay]
**LAY**
* **Check for slowed breathing or unresponsiveness.**
* Lay the person on their back and tilt the head up.
**SPRAY**
* **Insert device into either nostril** and press plunger firmly.
**STAY**
* **Call 911 immediately** after giving the first dose. Continue to administer doses every 2-3
  minutes and wait with the person until help arrives. Use as directed. 1 nasal spray device
  contains 1 dose. Safe to keep giving doses as needed.

# NARCAN^{®} NASAL SPRAY – ANYONE CAN SAVE A LIFE

Be ready – at home or on the go. NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray is a treatment designed to rapidly reverse
the effects of a life-threatening opioid emergency. Available as an over-the-counter medicine.

## BE PREPARED
## WITH NARCAN® NASAL SPRAY

Naloxone, the active ingredient in NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray, competes with opioids to bind with the
same receptors in the brain, reversing the effects of an opioid overdose in 2 to 3 minutes.

Carrying NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray can make all the difference in an opioid emergency.

### About Conference



After a successful conference of Pharmaceutica 2025, Pharma Conferences team cordially invites
participants from all over the world to attend **"27^{th} International Conference and Exhibition on
Pharmaceutics & Novel Drug Delivery Systems" **slated on August 20-21, 2026 in London, UK .
This [Pharmaceutics Conference][82] includes a wide range of Keynote presentations, Oral talks,
Poster presentations, Symposia, Workshops, Exhibitions and Career development programs.

[Novel drug delivery systems Conference][83] is one of the well-established conference
among [Pharmaceutical Conferences][84] organized by Conference Series

Pharmaceutica 2026 covers various aspects of Bio-Pharmaceutics, [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][85], Drug
Targeting and Design, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs, Pharmaceutical Formulation,
Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical Nanotechnology, [Novel Drug Delivery Systems][86],
Smart Drug Delivery Systems, [Nano medicine][87] and Biomedical Applications, Biomaterials in Drug
Delivery, Vaccine Drug Delivery Systems, Medical Devices for [Drug Delivery][88], Biologics
& [Biosimilars][89], Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutical Process Validation, Pharmaceutical
Packaging, [Clinical Trials][90] and [Clinical Research][91], Pharmacogenetics and Genomics,
Regulatory Affairs and Intellectual Property Rights, Industrial and Physical Pharmacy, Clinical and
Hospital Pharmacy, [Pharmacovigilance][92] and Drug Safety, Pharmacy Education and Practice

**2026 Highlights:**
* 200+ Participation (70% Industry: 30% Academia)
* 9+ Keynote Speakers
* 30+ Plenary Speakers
* 3+ Exhibitors
* 14 Innovative Educational Sessions
* B2B Meetings

# We Are a Company With a Clear Vision

Optinose is a specialty pharmaceutical company focused on creating and bringing to market innovative
products for patients with diseases treated by ear, nose, and throat (ENT) and allergy specialists.
Our mission is to improve the quality of life for patients. We will accomplish that by becoming the
leading specialty pharmaceutical company dedicated to creating innovative products that become
standard of care for diseases cared for directly by, or in consultation with, ENT and allergy
specialists.

Our first product for these patients uses one of our patented Bi-Directional™ Exhalation Delivery
Systems (EDS) to uniquely deliver a potent steroid deep into the nose where inflammation can be hard
to reach. Our EDS technology has other applications, such as in treatment of neurological or
psychiatric disorders.

Although these areas are not our focus, we have already successfully developed and out-licensed one
product in that space, and plan to partner with organizations who focus on central nervous system
treatments to develop more.

# We Are a Company With a Purpose

The Optinose team is unified by a common shared mission: to improve lives. We will accomplish this
while creating value for investors and the healthcare system along with better outcomes for patients
and providers. As innovators in every aspect of our work, we will pursue faster and less costly
product development, explore evolving commercial business models, and actively seek innovative ways
to be more effective and efficient. We are committed to working together as a team that chooses to
live every day by core company values that guide our daily behaviors, creating a foundation for
future success.

At Optinose, we are breaking through the conventional ways of thinking and doing. We are focused on
value creation, starting with our work on a unique and novel drug delivery concept known as
Bi-Directional Exhalation Delivery Systems. Our current efforts are centered on developing highly
differentiated products for large, underserved markets where EDS technology could redefine the
standard of care because it can deliver medication to where it’s needed.

# Breathing innovation into nasal drug delivery

The nose offers great potential as a patient-friendly pathway for local and systemic drug delivery.
Our expertise and technical capabilities in the development and manufacturing of nasal drug products
are designed to ensure that potential is realised for pharma partners.

## Key services for pharmaceutical partners
* **Nasal spray manufacturing capabilities**
  
  Our broad expertise in nasal drug delivery spans the entire product development cycle from
  formulation science to scale-up manufacture. Whether working with unit-dose, bi-dose or multi-dose
  products (preserved and sterile/non-preserved), the capabilities offered by our skilled in-house
  scientists and engineers ensures we can support any nasal project at any stage.
* **Nasal spray testing**
  
  Equipped with a state-of-the-art laboratory, we have the capabilities to conduct a wide range of
  nasal spray testing services across unit-dose, bi-dose and multi-dose devices, covering everything
  from particle-size distribution to plume geometry. The combination of detailed spray
  characterisation and decades of experience enable us to enhance and accelerate product
  development.
* **Nasal spray development**
  
  We are a specialist CDMO for nasal drug products, and our experience in the sector runs deep
  throughout the organisation. That means our partners can lean on our authoritative knowledge to
  guide and advance projects at any stage, from initial concept and testing through to device
  selection and commercialisation.
* **Site transfer**
  
  Balancing rigorous structure with the ability to flex manufacturing capacity, we can support the
  seamless transfer of intranasal products currently in commercial production. The process is
  closely monitored and managed by our experienced project managers, who are assigned to ensure
  project deadlines are met and transition to the facility is completed smoothly.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[Read →][18]
[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

[Learn More][112]
Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

# Welcome to WELLONA PHARMA

WELLONA PHARMA, based in Surat (Gujarat), India, is a well-established name in the field of
Pharmaceutical & Healthcare Industry. We are a Global Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and Exporting
company, renowned internationally for its quality standards and efficacy of the products. **WELLONA
PHARMA** is a leading Manufacturer and Exporter of **Pharmaceutical Finished Formulations** such as
Tablets, Capsules, Injections, Pre-filled Syringes, Inhalers/Respules, Nasal Sprays, Creams,
Ointments, Eye/Ear Drops, Syrups, Suspensions, Suppositories/Pessaries, Sachets, Powders, Lozenges,
Jelly & Lotions across the globe.

We have State-of-the-Art manufacturing facilities with **WHO-GMP, ISO 9001:2015** accreditations.
All the facilities are equipped with ultramodern technology. We have a robust product portfolio
comprising of Medicines spread over all the major therapeutic areas like Antibiotic, Antimalarial,
Antiviral, Antifungal, Anticancer, Antihypertensive, Anticonvulsant, Antidepressants, NSAID,
Painkiller, Anticoagulant, Antiprotozoal, Anesthetic, Antiallergic, Antidiabetic, Antacid,
Antidiarrhoeal, Laxative, Antiasthmatic, Erectile Dysfunction, Contraceptive, Vitamins, Hormones,
Skin care and many more. Currently, the company is into manufacturing and exporting of more than
1500 products worldwide.[Read More...][44]

# Drug and Biologic Delivery Systems

### Delivery device technology with a “patient-centric” focus.

We provide patient-centric delivery device technology and primary container packaging for
pharmaceutical, biotech and personal care companies worldwide. We combine novel technology and
technical services to provide solutions to challenging drug, biopharmaceutical, biologic or
botanical delivery applications tailored to meet your technical specifications and market
requirements. We utilize a technology platform approach in combination with technical services to
provide custom configured packaging and delivery systems for liquid, powder and reconstituted powder
formulations. Delivery systems for ophthalmic, systemic intranasal, nose to brain, sublingual,
buccal, and otic, routes of administration are available.

## [Routes of Drug Delivery][22]

We offer delivery device configurations for the following routes of administration

[][23]

### Ophthalmic

[][24]

### Intranasal

[][25]

### Nose to  Brain

[][26]

### Sublingual

[][27]

### Animal Care

## Analytical Services

Services include:
* Dispense Characterization via laser diffraction
* Dispense Plume Morphology via high speed video
* Aerodynamic Deposition (in-vitro upper and lower respiratory tracks)
* Delivered Dose Uniformity and Consistency
* Emitted Dose (shot weight/mass transfer)
* Size Exclusion Chromatography

## Pre-Commercial Services

Services include:
* combination product primary container/dispenser configuration and optimization
* prototype configuration and supply
* analytical testing (devices, primary containers, dispense characteristics)
* process engineering (fill process manufacturing)
* pre-clinical and clinical supply
* DMF, quality and regulatory documentation

## Commercial Services

Services include:
* commercial technology transfer
* commercial scale up
* DMF, quality and regulatory documentation
* commercial supply
* capital equipment supply and siting
* technology licensing 

[Learn More][28]
[Learn More][29]
[Learn More][30]

## Technology Platforms

Our ZTECH-L™ Delivery Platform is designed to package and deliver liquid drugs, biopharmaceuticals,
biologics and botanicals, while the ZTECH-P™ Delivery Platform is designed for powders or
reconstituted powder to liquid drug/device combination product applications.

[Technology Platforms][31]
[Devices][32]
[Primary Containers][33]

## Biosecurity

Zeteo Biomedical’s ZTECH-L™ and ZTECH-P™ drug and biologic delivery platforms provide solutions to
package and administer vaccines, anti-virals and biomedical countermeasures for infectious diseases
and bio-terror threats.  ZTECH-L™ and ZTECH-P™ nasal and sublingual delivery devices are readily
adaptable to public health needs, including rapid manufacturing and deployment to support both self
or caregiver administration options for vaccines, anti-virals and biomedical countermeasures across
large populations under crisis conditions.

[Learn More][34]

## **Applied Innovation**

Zeteo’s novel drug delivery systems require no priming. We provide consistent, precise dosing and
efficient unit dose packaging to reduce the cost per dose. Devices are available in mono-dose and
multi-dose configurations. The dose counter keeps track of administration, reducing dosing errors
and increasing adherence. The devices are compact, easily carried in a purse or pocket and, with a
small learning curve, enable patient simple self-administration. Our commercially scalable Form Fill
Seal packaging technology supports both non-sterile and aseptic fill processes.

[Learn more][35]

Zeteo’s novel drug delivery systems require no priming. We provide consistent, precise dosing and
efficient unit dose packaging to reduce the cost per dose. Devices are available in mono-dose and
multi-dose configurations. The dose counter keeps track of administration, reducing dosing errors
and increasing adherence. The devices are compact, easily carried in a purse or pocket and, with a
small learning curve, enable patient simple self-administration. Our commercially scalable Form Fill
Seal packaging technology supports both non-sterile and aseptic fill processes.

From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
